description: Describe the tables Mdexa can return rows from for one dataset: tables, columns (type, unit, codes, Refused / Don't know codes, lineage), keys and joinable tables. Call it before query_data. Most datasets forbid passing their data on: then the answer is data_available: false with the quoted terms, the field dictionary and where the recipe for your own machine is. A refusal is an answer, not an error; relay it. A non-blank value does not mean the person met the official collection or eligibility condition, and a blank does not mean "no": it can mean the question was not asked or the value was not computed.

columns.description: With table only: describe these columns only.

q.description: Find columns by name, source variable name or label: across the tables, or in table only. Not with columns, stats or cursor.

stats.description: With table only: per-column statistics (n, n_null, n_distinct, min, max, top_values, by_cycle).

table.description: Omit to list the tables of this version.
